The '''P-w401 ion maneuvering jet''' was manufactured by [[Sienar Fleet Systems/Legends|Sienar Fleet Systems]] to provide thrust propulsion for [[Starfighter/Legends|starfighters]] equipped with an [[Ion engine/Legends|ion drive]] system. Two were used on [[TIE series/Legends|TIE Series]] starfighters.
